metadata.description: Recomputes Avelino et al. (ESEM 2019) DOA/Truck-Factor/TFDD pipeline on GitHub repos and tests a NEW pre-departure authority-diffusion signal (founder commit-share + count of independent non-founder DOA file-owners in the 6-12mo window before a founder-only TFDD) against the paper's null snapshot covariates, via logistic regression (BH-FDR corrected), matched-pairs bootstrap, and a within-repo random-window placebo test.

success_criteria_verdict.notes: Corpus of 62 curated GitHub repos (dataset artifact dependency was empty at run time, see corpus_stats/notes). 47 passed prefilters, 30 yielded a founder-only TFDD with sufficient pre/post history. Snapshots are QUARTERLY (fallback_plan item 3) with a documented ~1.5mo TFDD-date fuzz. Placebo uses 200-target null draws (reduced from 1000 for CPU budget). DL(a,f) is implemented as the standard Fritz/Avelino definition: count of commits to f by OTHER authors after a's own last commit to f (not independently re-verified against the ICPC 2016 paper text at run time -- documented deviation from testing_plan step 1). REPORTING A NULL/NEGATIVE RESULT: corpus too small or effects do not clear thresholds; per fallback_plan, no fabrication/downsampling was applied.
